recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的顆粒（particle）中央有一顆大型巨核細胞，細胞內含多個彼此分離的圓形核，周圍夾雜造血細胞與脂肪空泡，提示多核、核葉分離的發育不良巨核細胞。
features: Large megakaryocyte within a marrow particle containing multiple separate round nuclei
Abundant grey-blue finely granular megakaryocyte cytoplasm
Surrounding cellular particle with myeloid and erythroid precursors, partly crushed
Numerous fat vacuoles and streaming red cells around the particle
describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle containing a large megakaryocyte with multiple discrete, widely separated round nuclei rather than a single lobulated nucleus, surrounded by granulocytic and erythroid precursors and fat vacuoles. Part of the particle is crushed, limiting assessment of individual precursor cells. Megakaryocytes with multiple separated nuclei are a recognized dysplastic form. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia in a myelodysplastic/myeloid neoplasm associated with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts have multiple uniform round nuclei with a single nucleolus each, pink granular cytoplasm and no platelet budding.
Normal megakaryocytes have connected nuclear lobes forming a single polylobated nucleus without discrete separate nuclei.
Tumor clusters show cohesive cells with distinct cell borders rather than a single cell with shared cytoplasm.
